lockFileMaintenance.description: lockFileMaintenance keeps its own default schedule (before 4am on monday) and ignores the top-level one, so repeat it here.

packageRules.description: Hold TypeScript on 6.x. TS 7.0 ships no compiler API, so typescript-eslint cannot run against it, tracked in typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint#10940. Lift this when typescript-eslint declares TS 7 support, not merely when 7.1 ships its API.
